entities.name: Lake Stymphalia
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Lake Stymphalia is located in the north-eastern part of the Peloponnese, in Corinthia, southern Greece. It is a closed karst basin with a wetland area and an agrarian area. The lake is an important stopover for migratory birds. The size of the lake varies, depending on the season.
